process.title: Free Consultation
process.description: Meet our designer at your site or our studio to discuss your space, style and timelines.

process.title: Requirement Discussion
process.description: We understand how your family lives, your storage needs and your budget.

process.title: Design Planning
process.description: Layouts, mood boards and 3D views so you can see your home before work begins.

process.title: Material Selection
process.description: Choose finishes, fabrics and hardware from curated, quality-checked options.
